title: Exploring the molecular mechanisms of phthalates in the comorbidity of preeclampsia and depression by integrating multiple datasets.
authors: Tian, Xinpeng; Gu, Xia; Yuan, Yuecheng; Zhang, Yaqiong; Ma, Yantuanjin; Liu, Yingliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组数据探索子痫前期与抑郁共病的分子机制，虽涉及转录因子调控预测和分子对接，但核心是疾病生物标志物与免疫机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法上仅用机器学习筛选基因，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Preeclampsia (PE) and depressive disorder (DD) exhibit clinical comorbidity, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying this association remain poorly understood. METHODS: Differential expression analysis of placental and peripheral blood transcriptomes was performed to identify PE-associated secretory protein genes. A depression-related coexpression network was constructed to obtain DD-related genes. Protein-protein interaction integration and functional enrichment analyses were then applied to identify shared regulatory pathways. Machine learning algorithms were applied to select core diagnostic genes, followed by validation in independent cohorts. A nomogram model was developed, and gene set enrichment, immune cell infiltration analysis, transcription factor regulatory mapping, and molecular docking with plasticizer compounds were conducted. RESULTS: A total of 434 secretory protein genes were associated with PE, whereas the depression-related network identified 1,165 DD-associated genes. Immune-related pathways and extracellular-matrix remodeling emerged as common mechanisms. CLEC3B, CTLA4, and PDPR were identified as core diagnostic genes and showed robust predictive performance in the nomogram model. These genes were enriched in immune-related signaling pathways, including the B-cell receptor and NOD-like receptor pathways. Aberrant proportions of naive CD4(+) T cells were observed, and gene expression correlated with specific immune-cell populations. Multiple transcription factors were predicted to regulate the three genes. Molecular docking indicated stable interactions between the encoded proteins and plasticizer compounds, suggesting potential environmental contributions to comorbidity. DISCUSSION: The findings provide molecular evidence linking vascular dysfunction in PE with immune-related mechanisms in DD and highlight potential biomarkers for early diagnosis and therapeutic intervention.
abstract_zh: 引言：先兆子痫（Preeclampsia, PE）与抑郁障碍（depressive disorder, DD）在临床上表现出共病现象，但这一关联背后的分子机制仍知之甚少。方法：对胎盘和外周血转录组进行差异表达分析，以识别与PE相关的分泌蛋白基因。构建抑郁相关共表达网络，获取DD相关基因。随后应用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用整合和功能富集分析，以识别共享调控通路。采用机器学习算法筛选核心诊断基因，并在独立队列中进行验证。构建列线图模型，并进行基因集富集、免疫细胞浸润分析、转录因子调控图谱绘制以及与增塑剂化合物的分子对接。结果：共434个分泌蛋白基因与PE相关，而抑郁相关网络识别出1,165个DD相关基因。免疫相关通路和细胞外基质重塑被确定为共同机制。CLEC3B、CTLA4和PDPR被识别为核心诊断基因，并在列线图模型中表现出稳健的预测性能。这些基因富集于免疫相关信号通路，包括B细胞受体和NOD样受体通路。观察到初始CD4(+) T细胞比例异常，且基因表达与特定免疫细胞群体相关。预测多个转录因子调控这三个基因。分子对接表明编码蛋白与增塑剂化合物之间存在稳定相互作用，提示环境因素可能对共病有潜在贡献。讨论：研究结果提供了分子证据，将PE中的血管功能障碍与DD中的免疫相关机制联系起来，并强调了早期诊断和治疗干预的潜在生物标志物。
